senses.gloss:
कैरव m. (-वः)
 1. A rogue, a cheat.
 2. An enemy.
 f. (-वी) Moonlight.
 n.
(वं)
 1. The white esculent water lily.
 2. Fraud, trick.
 E. केरव here
said to mean, a goose, from के in water, and रु to sound, with अप्
affix; again, अण् affix, liked by the geese; or किरव a cheat, &c. or
कैरव a lotus, and अण् affix, implying identity or resemblance.

कैरविणी f. (-णी) A place abounding in lotus flowers, or an assemblage
of lotuses.
 E. कैरव a white lotus, इनि and ङीष् affs.

कैरविन् m. (-वी) The moon.
 E. कैरवी moonlight, इनि aff.
कैराटक m. (-कः) A species ef poison, one of the fixed kinds.

कैरात n. (-तं)
 1. A sort of gentian, commonly Cherayta, (Gentiana
cherayta, Rox)
 2. A kind of Sandal.
 m. (-तः) A strong man. E.
किरात gentian, &c. अण् aff.
